# 本地语音交互AI系统（Local Voice-Interactive AI System）— External dependencies

No LiveTalking vendor code, model, media, submodule or patch is bundled. The intended third_party/LiveTalking path is absent and ignored to prevent accidental inclusion. See [external boundary](../docs/third-party/EXTERNAL_LIVETALKING.md) and [publication gates](../docs/release/PUBLICATION_BLOCKERS.md). This is not a complete runtime package.
